exposure.needed: whether operators run `flux push artifact --provider azure` from Azure DevOps runners (CLI usage in CI pipelines, not cluster configuration)

consequence.statement: A bug fix: on Azure DevOps runners, `flux push artifact --provider azure` can now call the Azure CLI. Operators do not need to do anything.
consequence.remediation: None needed. If your CI pipelines on Azure DevOps had a workaround for this, check that it is still needed.

assertion.statement: In Flux 2.7.0, `flux push artifact --provider azure` is allowed to call the Azure CLI when it runs on Azure DevOps runners.
